title: Melissa NDE 363
content: After I was taken to hospital and in coma, I distinctly remember things. I remember telling my family to turn off lights and shut blinds because it was too bright in the room. They tell me the lights are off and it is 9:00 at night. I remember telling my parents about an angel floating next to my TV screen. I remember a man in a white gown standing beside doctors as they examined me. I remember meeting my grandparents who died before my birth. I was able to tell things I never would have known otherwise. I can't describe all I've been through in this little amount of space/time.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Had tree limb fall on me... Clinical death In coma for six months. Received Traumatic Brain Injury. Maintaining a 4.0 in college. Had tree limb fall on me and take my life.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | Light | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I could see myself lying in bed with people shouting for me to wake up, but could do nothing to wake myself up.
elements.At what time during the experience were: In coma for six months. Not conscious, unaware of people around me.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They walked into the hospital room - my deceased grandparents I had never met. Asked questions about how I enjoyed life.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Was usually bright in room, until times where all was dark.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Very depressed. Guilty for what I put others through. Always questioning why this happened to me. Grateful to experience such nice times in my life. Thus far.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Never take anything in life for granted!!! You never know when it could all disappear.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I knew loved ones wanted me to return, but were choosing to pull plug on life support, fearing that they would not like what I returned as. This really hurt, I tried yelling, 'What are you thinking?!?!'
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I knew loved ones wanted me to return, but were choosing to pull plug on life support, fearing that they would not like what I returned as. This really hurt, I tried yelling, 'What are you thinking?!?!' God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Your last day could be tomorrow. Do everything in your power to accomplish all possibilities around you.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes To admit that I was clinically dead for two and half minutes, on life support for three months. Hard to believe I was once dead but have been given life back.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I am stubborn. It took such a long period of time to be able to walk, talk, or live life as a 'normal' person does.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes All have been shocked. Have been donating blood for me, if I ask them to. This has increased the blood supply in the area.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: What were friends/ family member's reactions?
